id: \rI didn't bring my best. Wait until next time!
en: \rI didn't bring my best. Wait until next time!
it: \rNon ho dato il meglio di me. Aspetta la prossima volta!

id: \rErika might be quiet, but she is famous around here.
en: \rErika might be quiet, but she is famous around here.
it: \rErika sarà anche tranquilla, ma da queste parti è famosa.

id: \bErika uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
en: \bErika uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
it: \bErika usa Pokémon di tipo Erba. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Fuoco, Veleno, Volante e Ghiaccio.

id: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock. Electirc, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock.  Electirc, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Acqua, Terra e Roccia. Anche le mosse di tipo Elettro, Erba, Terra e Acqua non fanno loro molti danni.

id: \rOh you were looking at Erika...\nYou weren't looking at me...
en: \rOh you were looking at Erika...\nYou weren't looking at me...

id: \rWe only use Grass-type Pokémon in this Gym.
en: \rWe only use Grass-type Pokémon in this Gym.
it: \rIn questa Palestra usiamo solo Pokémon di tipo Erba.

id: \rWe only accept girls in our Gym.
en: \rWe only accept girls in our Gym.

it: \rSpero che Erika ti faccia a pezzi!

id: \rI have a date coming up. I have to learn to be polite, especially if I have to battle.
en: \rI have a date coming up. I have to learn to be polite, especially if I have to battle.
it: \rTra poco ho un appuntamento. Devo imparare a essere educata, soprattutto se dovrò lottare.

id: \rGrass types are tough against Water types.
en: \rGrass types are tough against Water types.
it: \rI tipi Erba sono ostici per i tipi Acqua.

id: \rErika: Yawn... Oh, hello. Welcome to my Gym. I'm not really in the mood to battle, so would you mind coming back later?
en: \rErika: Yawn... Oh, hello. Welcome to my Gym. I'm not really in the mood to battle, so would you mind coming back later?
it: \rErika: Uaaah... Oh, ciao. Benvenuto nella mia Palestra. Non ho proprio voglia di lottare, ti dispiace tornare più tardi?

id: \rAlright, fine. I guess we can battle now, but only because it's a rule.
en: \rAlright, fine. I guess we can battle now, but only because it's a rule.
it: \rE va bene. Credo che possiamo lottare adesso, ma solo perché è la regola.
\rErika: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Arcobaleno.

id: \rTM53 contains Energy Ball. It does damage and has a chance to lower the Special Defense of the opponent.
en: \rTM53 contains Energy Ball. It does damage and has a chance to lower the Special Defense of the opponent.
it: \rL'MT53 contiene Energipalla. Infligge danni e può ridurre la Difesa Speciale dell'avversario.

id: \rErika: Aren't the perfume and flowers here just lovely?
en: \rErika: Aren't the perfume and flowers here just lovely?
it: \rErika: Il profumo e i fiori di questo posto non sono deliziosi?
